rule: Parse timestamp as Unix seconds and write UTC ISO-8601
reason: ListenBrainz source records use a top-level Unix timestamp.

rule: Trim text and collapse repeated whitespace; preserve display-name case
reason: Remove formatting noise without changing intended artist or track names.

rule: Convert duration seconds to milliseconds; keep duration_ms as provided
reason: The sample contains both source representations.

rule: Keep UUID-shaped MBIDs; store credited artist IDs as a pipe-separated list
reason: IDs support later artist-level grouping; malformed IDs cannot join reliably.

rule: Remove exact duplicates after normalization, but retain key conflicts and flag them
reason: Exact repeated submissions add no event information; different payloads sharing the listen key may be distinct events.

rule: Drop rows without user_id or a parseable timestamp; leave other missing fields missing
reason: Those rows cannot be assigned to a listener or time period, while incomplete metadata can still represent a real listen.

rule: Remove future-dated listens; flag out-of-month and implausible durations
reason: Future listens are impossible as of the run; other unusual values require review rather than automatic deletion.

rule: Flag users above the 99.5th percentile of retained listen counts
reason: Heavy activity is unusual but not necessarily erroneous.
